reconstruction_accuracy.note: texts-only front-end at gold boundary; cross-check vs tree_reconstruct_hitab_raw_merged

metric: set-EM@k (all gold operand cells ranked <= k)

arms.S2_gold: my method on GOLD tree (perfect structure = ceiling)
arms.S2_recon: my method on RECONSTRUCTED tree (what raw data gets)
arms.S2_shuffled: CONTROL: reconstructed paths with the ancestor prefix permuted across lines — same length, same vocabulary, wrong assignment. S2_recon - S2_shuffled is the part of the gain that is actually structural; S2_shuffled - flat is the part that is just longer strings.
arms.S2_gold_trunc: CONTROL: GOLD paths cut to the reconstructed depth from the leaf end — every kept segment correct, but as short as reconstruction. Tests whether S2_recon out-retrieves S2_gold because gold's extra ancestors dilute the embedding rather than because recon is better.
